en: How dare Miu call me stupid!

How the heck are we supposed to 
cross this without a bridge!?

H-Hey! You called me stupid again!?
What's the big idea!?

Hey...are we really gonna use that 
thin wooden board as a bridge?

That's dangerous!
Miu's the stupid one here, not me!

Hey bro, I'll let you go first!
Don't hesitate! Just go ahead and cross!
<CLT=cltMIND>So you're going to make *me* test it?

I'll let you go first, since I'm so considerate 
to my sidekicks!

Kaito Momota
Rooftop After passing map loading point
...We really gonna use that board to cross?
Gonta really heavy... Sure it's okay?
Wow! Gonta stand on board, no problem!

Or is Gonta less heavy cuz he look like
this now?
Gonta? What's wrong?
Ah...

Compared to the data in my memory bank,
you appear to be unwell.

Did Kokichi do something to you? Or did he
make you do something dangerous?
No... Gonta just not feel good...

Oh, are you getting motion sickness 
from the 3D maybe?
Ocean sickness...? But this river, not ocean...
No, I said "motion sickness," Gonta.

Some people start to feel sick when they
look at 3D effects or VR for too long.

It's probably that. I'm sure it's just because 
you're not used to things like this, Gonta...

Umm...Gonta not really understand...
But Gonta probably okay...

Ah, perhaps you should take a break...
Do you want to log out ahead of us?
L-Log out...?

Umm, explaining it to you might 
be a little hard, Gonta...

So why don't you head back to the academy
before us and get some rest?

N-No! Gonta fine!
Just feel a little sick, that all!

There maybe something Gonta can do
here to help...
So Gonta wanna stay with everyone!
Yeah...you would say that.

Then let's all head to the chapel together.
Gonta, if you're feeling nauseous, let us know.
Okay...

Gonta fine, really...
Sorry to worry you...
What is this wavy line?

If Shuichi disappears after he walks
through it...
I'll cry, y'know that!?
<CLT=cltMIND>Crocodile tears again...

Kokichi Oma
Outdoors After passing map loading point

This river is flowing quite fast. If you fell
in, it might just wash you away.

I, um, did not know you had such...unique
proclivities...
...Should I re-evaluate how I perceive you?
Th-That *won't* be necessary!

I, um, did not know you had such...unique
proclivities...
...Should I re-evaluate how I perceive you?
Th-That *won't* be necessary!

Despite being told that objects here do not
break, this signboard still seems unreliable.
We managed to cross without any incident.

According to my calcuations, my weight
should have broken the bridge...

But since objects here are indestructible,
it merely buckled without snapping.

As long as it doesn't get washed away,
it's good enough to use as a bridge.

And even if it does get washed away, we can
just use you as a bridge, Kee-boy.
Why me!?

Don't worry, you even said it yourself!
Objects don't break in this world!
Please don't treat me like an object!
Your robophobia is too much, Kokichi...
Moving through a map loading point...

I never imagined I would ever experience
anything like that.
We're not leaving footprints in this snow...

It feels weird. Like I've become a ghost 
without feet.

Well? Get to it. Savor the joy of carrying 
out orders.

Good job, looks like you got it.
Go report back to your master.

I-If I could use my magic here...
I could levitate over this river, super easy.

That was so scary...
It still feels like my heart is going crazy.

Though, I don't know if these bodies 
even have hearts or not...

Shouldn't we go after Kokichi, too?
He's always up to no good...
It's really piled up outside.

Kaito would be excited for all this snow.
I bet he would make a snowman or something...
Maki...is *that* how you see me?

Because you always look so pleased when
Kaito's giving you orders.
Pleased!?

But you seem happy as the sidekick.
Maybe you're just into that sort of thing.

Whatever, just hurry it up. Or do you prefer
taking orders from Kaito?
N-No, it's not like that, really...
Maki...is *that* how you see me?

Because you always look so pleased when
Kaito's giving you orders.
Pleased!?

But you seem happy as the sidekick.
Maybe you're just into that sort of thing.

Whatever, just hurry it up. Or do you prefer
taking orders from Kaito?
L-Like I said, it doesn't matter...

When Miu and Kokichi crossed over a little
while ago...

...it bent so much that it seemed like it'd
break, but now it's back to normal.
So...objects really can't break in this world.

I wonder what that wavy line on the map
means...

It doesn't seem like Miu wants to explain it,
so I guess we'll have to check it out.
...I say "we," but I mean "you."
<CLT=cltMIND>Me?

Maki Harukawa
Outdoors After passing map loading point

There's a field of snow all around us, but it's
made so it'll never pile up on the road.

That's a relief... I won't have to worry 
about getting lost now.
I see... So you're like that, Shuichi...
<CLT=cltMIND>Is this...pity I'm sensing?
I see... So you're like that, Shuichi...
<CLT=cltMIND>Is this...pity I'm sensing?

I-Is it safe? If we fall into the river when 
it's this cold, it won't be a laughing matter.
Ah! It's cold!

Let's hurry and get to the chapel! Even if it's
only a little warmer than out here!
I see, so it has to load the next map.

Places like this remind you that this world was
created by a program on a computer.

Quit takin' your sweet-ass time!
Hurry up and come on me!
Er, I mean...come with me! Hurry up!

C'mon on, hurry up! Get on all fours and
go get it!

C'mon on, hurry up! Get on all fours and
go get it!

Why don't you go on ahead to that point
and find out what it is for yourselves?
Well, that was fun!

Don't worry! Passing through the map
loading point won't affect your avatars!

There's no bridge after all. How are we 
supposed to cross the river now?

Just so you know, my magic doesn't 
work in this world!
Don't tell me... Do we have to swim?

Fine, I won't tell you... Besides, you can't
go in the river in the Virtual World.
Then...should we use something as a boat?

Geez, you're not even trying to hide
your stupidity!

The river's current is too fast!
A boat will get swept away easily!
So we need a bridge then, right?
I told you, we already got a bridge!

There's a wider river downstream that
connects to this one.

Next to it, there's a long signboard that
says "Mirai Hills."

Apparently it was meant for the mansion,
but we can use it as a makeshift bridge.
So we just need to get that signboard?

Yeah, but I'll ask the masochist to go get it!
He just looooves bein' bossed around!
Shuichi! Go get the signboard!
What? Me?
...Yeah, go get the signboard.
Huh?
Yeah. You're a total masochist.
Huh!?

Wait a minute...
Do you *all* think that about me?

Just to make it special, I want you to get it
while you crawl like a dog!
No...I think I'll walk normally, thank you.

There's a wider river downstream that
connects to this one.

Next to it, there's a long signboard that
says "Mirai Hills."

Apparently it was meant for the mansion,
but we can use it as a makeshift bridge.

Just to make it special, I want you to get it
while you crawl like a dog!
No...I think I'll walk normally, thank you.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the signboard.
It says "Mirai Hills."

I just need to grab this and
head back to the others.
Is this the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've earned 1 Monocoin.
Something shiny...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've earned 3 Monocoins.
So this is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've earned 7 Monocoins.
Hey! I thought I told you to crawl like a dog!
...You actually thought I'd be on all fours?

Whatever. Quit wastin' time and lay the
signboard across the river.
Alright then...

See? It fits perfectly! We have ourselves
a bridge now!

We're gonna walk over this shabby-looking
signboard? It's definitely gonna break.

Your brain must be smaller than your tits!
I told you, objects don't break in this world!

Oh, so even this crappy signboard can
be a sturdy bridge in this world, huh?

This signboard is the only bridge we got!
So don't fuck up and let it get washed away!

If this signboard gets washed away by the
river, we won't have a bridge anymore!
Alright already. Sheesh, you're so annoying.
Huh? There's a bridge!

Oh, thank god! I gave up when I realized I had
no way to cross the river.
Where were you and what were you doing?

Oh, I was in the forest over there looking for
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

But unfortunately, I couldn't find it... Welp, I
wasn't expecting it to be that easy anyway.
...Right, Gonta?
Yeah...

Perfect! It's more convenient when we're
all together anyway.
Hm? What do you mean, convenient?

N-Nothing! Urgh, whatever...
Let's just cross the river!

Hurry up and get over here, guys! It's too
late to head back now, okay?

Nyeeeh...that was stressful. But the thing
about objects not breaking was true.
That's what I've been sayin'!

Aren't we just beyond the 
wavy line drawn on the map?

You'll find out if you keep goin' forward.
Why don't you go check it out?
<CLT=cltMIND>...This is disconcerting.
What...was that?
Wh-What was that!? What just happened!?

For a second...it felt like I lost consciousness
and everything went black. And now I'm here.

That didn't happen to our bodies, but it
happened to this world.
Huh? What do you mean?

But that is an accurate description.
As if the world itself switched over...
Could it be...loading?
Correct! I mean, uh...erect!

Umm, you said the right word the
first time.

Anyway, Four-Eyes is right... You all just
passed through the <CLT=cltSTRONG>map loading point<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

In some games, if you go in a building, it'll
take a moment for the inside to fully load.

Well, the outside is like that too, cuz the
Virtual World is divided into two large maps.

That wavy line represents where the two
maps meet.

Think of these two maps as if they're
two different rooms.

In the same way you have to go through
a door to move between two rooms...

To move between the two maps, you have
to pass through the <CLT=cltSTRONG>map loading point<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Is that why we can't see past that
point on the binoculars on the roof?

Obviously, you can't see what's inside one
room when you're standing inside the other.
Ooohh, a map loading point.

Ah-haha, how fun. So not only does your sight
get cut off, but sound cuts off, too.

Yeah, you can't hear anything at all while
you're inside the map loading point.
<CLT=cltMIND>So no sound goes through either...

So the chapel is over here, right?
Well, I'm gonna go on ahead theeeen.

Hey, don't just go on ahead! I don't trust
you being off alone by yourself!

...It's because you pay attention to him that
you're more likely to be tricked.
<CLT=cltMIND>Let's try going to the chapel.
